prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-realistic minimalist studio portrait of one original approved adult man against a deep red background.
prompt.main_subject: Original approved adult man with clean haircut, short well-groomed beard, calm composed expression and red-tinted rectangular sunglasses. He wears a fitted black turtleneck and faces slightly to the side with a modern technology-founder editorial presence.
composition_elements: Waist-up to chest-up portrait with subject slightly off-center against a deep red studio backdrop.
Strong black-red contrast, clean negative space and controlled sunglasses reflections.
Preserve turtleneck, glasses, haircut, expression and minimalist fashion hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft directional key light with subtle fill, gentle face shadows, controlled red reflections in the glasses and cinematic contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic 4:5 portrait, 85mm lens at f/2.8, shallow depth of field, crisp face, beard, fabric and glasses detail, subtle grain, no text or watermark.
